Drafted 4th RENEWABLE ENERGY PROGRESS REPORT OF KOSOVO 2018-2019, according to the Renewable Energy Directive 2009/28/EC as adapted by the Ministerial Council Decision 2012/04/MC-EnC of the Energy Community. 4.3. Support KCCC, to building political will and ownership and engagement to implement the priorities under APCC through regular coordination meetings with the key national stakeholders (key ministries, local governments, CSOs, youth, academia, private sector. 4.3. Support the Institutions on rapid assessment of contributions of the private sector initiatives, related to renewables (solar and small hydro) and setting targets for the RES for period 2021 -2030 as per Energy Community Secretariat. 5.1.Estimate costs of priority actions, technology options, and aggregate to reflect in APCC 5.2.Analyse and Propose alternative funding sources/ Impact investment platform for CC actions, including those where public finance could be leveraged and/or realigned. 6.1. Support KCCC to conduct inclusive and consultative approach with youth and women on CC mitigation and adaptation 6.2. Set up of the monitoring platform to monitor progress and impact of implemented climate actions actions through improving data for tracking progress of APCC..

2.2. Implemented 10 pilot urban NAMAs resulting in: o Reduction up to 30% of GHG emissions through installation of the PV solar energy for the public municipal administrative building, o Saving up to 25% of energy through application of Energy Efficient roof insulation of the public municipal administrative building, o Demonstration of the impact of green urban spaces in city microclimates, climate change and air quality through implementation of smart green retrofitting with innovative technology solutions in 13 different locations in the city through: ? Green walking path for visually impaired pedestrians ? Smart green area solutions, ? Charging stations with PV solar energy panels for electric vehicles. ? Smart bike charging stations with PV solar energy panels, and wheelchairs for people with disabilities. ? Innovative smart bus stations with PV solar energy panels and wheelchairs for people with disabilities 3.1 Regular consultation with KCCCs Technical Secretariat and GHG emission team held by project. However due to frequent political changes the KCCC regular coordination meetings did not took place. 4.3 Kosovo Fourth Progress Report on promotion and use of energy from renewable energy sources, 2018-2019, was submitted to Energy Community treaty on February 2021. Kosovo drafted the Concept Paper on Renewable Energy Sources to define new targets in line with requirements of the Energy Community Secretariat at the end of March 2021. 5.1 Completed the “Assessment Report Climate change actions in Kosovo”_ current state of affairs and way forward, includes the analysis of the policies and regulatory reform, designing of the dialogue with Private Sector, type of incentives and facilitation of the private sector contribution in the renewable energy sector. 5.2. Completed the “Assessment Report Climate change actions in Kosovo”_ current state of affairs and way forward, includes the analysis of the policies and regulatory reform, designing of the dialogue with Private Sector, type of incentives and facilitation of the private sector contribution in the renewable energy sector and financing opportunities. 6.1 The KCCC will take in consideration to update the indicators and contributions to the achievement of the SDG and indicating in next APCC which is to be developed for next three years 2022 – 2025, considering youth and gender inclusion. 6.2 Summary brief paper - Action Plan for Climate Change Monitoring and Reporting/ included recommendation to: • Develop mechanisms for tracking the investments in CC mitigation; • Conduct robust analytical work for scenario development and emissions projections, creating thus a solid analytical base for future revisions; • Include evaluation of co-benefits of mitigation measures and use them among the criteria for prioritization. • Develop mechanisms for tracking the investments in CC adaptation.
